title: Smoother chat scrolling and keyboard gestures
summary: Chat gives your scroll gesture priority, keeps incoming messages from shifting your reading position, and makes keyboard dismissal steadier.

sections.heading: Scroll and reading position
items: Scrolling upward releases bottom-follow immediately, including the first few pixels of a drag.
Incoming messages wait behind the newer-messages control while you are reading, keeping the displayed chat window stable.
Delayed media, typing and keyboard layout updates respect your scroll gesture. General, DMs, threads and Pins share the fix.

sections.heading: Keyboard and phone push setup
items: The compact down chevron still dismisses the keyboard. A downward swipe near Send now owns its gesture without dragging the page.
Phone push enrollment is repaired on the server; native delivery is being validated separately with a limited tester canary.
Tap Restart Now to load this update.
